description: This is a Java test source file for the class RetrieveSubject. It contains unit tests verifying the behavior of RetrieveSubject, including JSON serialization/deserialization, immutability, equality, and constructor input validation.

classes.name: RetrieveSubjectTest
classes.description: Unit test class for RetrieveSubject, testing constructor validation, JSON serialization/deserialization, immutability, and equality.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Tests that RetrieveSubject instances are immutable and that related classes (Label, SubjectId, PolicyId) are also immutable.

methods.name: testHashCodeAndEquals
methods.description: Verifies that RetrieveSubject's equals and hashCode methods are correctly implemented using EqualsVerifier.

methods.name: tryToCreateInstanceWithNullPolicyId
methods.description: Ensures that creating a RetrieveSubject with a null PolicyId throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: tryToCreateInstanceWithNullPolicyIdString
methods.description: Ensures that creating a RetrieveSubject with a null PolicyId string throws PolicyIdInvalidException.

methods.name: tryToCreateInstanceWithInvalidPolicyId
methods.description: Verifies that an invalid PolicyId string results in a PolicyIdInvalidException.

methods.name: tryToCreateInstanceWithNullLabel
methods.description: Checks that passing null label throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: tryToCreateInstanceWithNullSubjectId
methods.description: Checks that passing null subjectId throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: toJsonReturnsExpected
methods.description: Verifies that the toJson method returns the expected JSON representation of RetrieveSubject.

methods.name: createInstanceFromValidJson
methods.description: Validates that RetrieveSubject can be instantiated from a valid JSON string and its fields match expectations.
